name: Yuuwaku Lab ~Kiken na Koi no Houteishiki~
original_name: 誘惑ラボ～キケンな恋の方程式～
source:
Joining a team of highly-skilled engineers on a highly-classified robotics project, your assignment―as a top-notch clinical psychologist―is to advise, instruct and insinuate these eye-catching, outstanding male researchers on… how to love!?

"Go ahead and demonstrate, it’s your job anyway. Who cares if it’s just a kiss?”

Staining these white lab walls…is a romance, unequated?

The web of intrigue surrounding ‘Project Adam’…Ask yourself… if 'love’ truly exists.

[from [url=http://www.englishotomegames.net/post/159246902116/decodingdesire]English Otome Games[/url]]
translation:
加入一个由高技能工程师组成的团队，参与一个高度机密的机器人项目，作为一名顶尖的临床心理学家，你的任务是向这些引人注目的杰出男性研究人员提供建议、指导和暗示……如何去爱！？

“来吧，展示一下，反正这是你的工作。谁在乎这只是一个吻呢？”

给这些白色的实验室墙壁染色……是一种浪漫，无与伦比的吗？

围绕“亚当计划”的阴谋网……问问自己……“爱”是否真的存在。

[来自[url=http://www.englishotomegames.net/post/159246902116/decodingdesire]English Otome Games[/url]]
